items.problem: `resolution` of `resolve_report` is written to the `block_report_report` row, but neither this spec nor the body rules of `admin-api` (skills/server-core/modules/admin-api.md:178, which set only the byte limit and a non-empty `operation_id`) exclude U+0000. A JSON body `{"resolution": "a\u0000b"}` passes the body check; on SQLite (LOCAL) the row stores it, on PostgreSQL (DEV, STG, PROD) the write fails with an encoding error and the operation is 500 `internal`. An implementation that rejects it as `bad_request` is equally allowed, so the observable failure value is not set. The diff adds the "holds no U+0000" rule only to `ref` and `evidence` of the same row. Fix direction: a body rule in `admin-api` that a string holds no U+0000 (`bad_request`), which covers every admin string written to the DB
